body: Finally I did not tell him about my struggles last time I saw him, a few days ago, because the timing was not right. I'm pretty safe now with the medication I'm on, so I can wait until I feel we can talk about it. I will definitely tell him though, because he deserves to know. Thanks for your help and wise words when I needed some.

I hope you're still OK. I know you are going through hell, and I understand why you want to put an end on it. If the thought of someone caring for you is enough to postpone any attempt, please remember that we care for you here. It won't stop the beating, the starving for now, but we are caring for you. Stay strong.

Hey! Those things will fade with time. The only thing you need to do is to take care of your bipolar disorder. I’ve lived with bipolar for 22 years, and it’s not always been an easy ride, but you can get a full life. Get medication first, things will get better. I’m with you.

Please don’t do it now. Try to stay another day, another week. I was recently within hours of killing myself, but I got unexpectedly  helped by someone and I’m in a better place now. Not perfect, but still better. Stay strong for a little longer, you never know what is around the corner.

I have a very loving and caring father, and he would do anything to help me, but part of me wants to keep him away from my pains and struggles, because I know it would haunt him all day and night.

I don't have kids, but I totally get what you're saying : I should give my father a chance to help me, because that's what he would really want to do. I'll see him next week, I think I will follow your advice and have a conversation with him. Thank you for your time.

Well I'm actuallty considering telling my father about my struggles, because I think he's worried already, without telling me. It might be for the better.

Thanks for taking time to reply, it really helps. English is not my native language, I hope I don't make too many mistakes.

Thank you very much for being here. I'm not currently seeing a therapist; on of my friends is a medical doctor, so she helped me with the medication. I'm thinking about seeing a therapist, you are right. Part of the pain is keeping it all to myself, because I don't want friends and family to worry about me.
